ios.desc:
Lose weight and keep it off with Noom.

Millions of people trust Noom because it pairs medication with mindset, giving you the tools, support, and science-backed strategies to build lasting habits. The app gives you all-in-one access to step tracking, meal logging with AI, face and body scanning with health insights, and rewards just for showing up.

Whether you're building better habits with Noom Weight or working with a clinician on Noom Med, you'll get a weight loss plan tailored to your goals and lifestyle.

FEATURES
- AI food logging with 1M+ food items, protein & calorie tracking
- Access to GLP-1 meds, if eligible
- Body scans for real-time insights
- Meal plans & dietitian-backed recipes
- 1,000+ fitness, stretching & meditation classes
- Daily lessons on habits, & behavior change
- Supportive communities
- Sync with Apple Health, Fitbit, Garmin & more
- Optional 1:1 coaching

What people are saying:

“An evidence-based lifestyle behavior change program.” - Mashable
“Cost-effective and accessible to everyone looking to help manage their weight loss." - Newsweek
“Helped me reimagine my food choices without forcing me to completely cut out any foods.” - Healthline

NOOM WEIGHT

A sustainable weight loss program to help you change the habits behind your health through lessons and science-backed tools.

- Avg. weight loss: 15 lbs in 15 weeks¹
- 95% say it’s a long-term weight loss solution2
- 98% say it changed their habits for good2
- Supports intermittent fasting & behavior-based food logging
- Stay consistent with coaches, content & community

Plans as low as $17 a month.3

NOOM MED

Combine proven GLP-1 meds with the tools and support to lose weight and keep it off—even if you stop medication.

- If eligible, access trusted GLP-1s like Ozempic®4, Wegovy®, Zepbound®5 or Mounjaro®5
- Or choose Noom GLP-1Rx with SmartDose, a personalized dosing system designed for a smoother, more effective GLP-1 experience
- Meds shipped to your door in 7 days,6 if prescribed 7
- Microdose GLP-1Rx options available, designed to deliver effective results and minimize side effects
- 100% online access to doctors & health coaches
- GLP-1 Companion Program with Muscle Defense™ to lose fat, protect muscle, & build healthy habits
- Pairing GLP-1 medication with Noom habits leads to ~37% more weight loss 8

Plans start at $39 a month.9

¹ Based on a 3.5 year study of actively engaged Noom users with a minimum starting BMI of 25.

2 Based on a sample of 4,272 Noomers.

3 Bas

quotes.text:
Can someone help me understand: The weight loss app "Noom" [1] asks for your credit card info, in the app itself, when you start using it. They even include a 15 minute countdown timer to pressure you into quickly taking advantage of an "offer". You're charged some small amount of money for a trial, which is automatically converted to a fairly expensive subscription after two weeks.

This is a completely digital service, and they're just ignoring in-app purchases completely. How do they get away with that? Are there exceptions for subscriptions? The app comes across as a scam to me, but it's not exactly an obscure product.

Or maybe they use AB tests or something that hides this from the app review team?

[1] https://apps.apple.com/us/app/noom/id634598719

Addendum for reference... I did screenshot the credit card form. This is in the app it self, not on a separate website. [2]

[2] https://imgur.com/a/756LXwQ
